comment: How the golden-run port of this example is assembled onto a repository created from the template: each overlay directory is copied onto the repository root in order (a later one wins, README.md excepted), then each `copy` entry is taken from this example and written to `to` with its `replace` pairs applied, then `engine_dependencies` are added to the root package.json at the versions this example pins. Template-owned: scripts/verify/golden-check.mjs assembles and tests it in CI, and the Factory's golden-run replay developer reads the same file.
